_comment: Paste the "marketingOs" block below into data/config.json (a top-level key, next to "email", "db", "brand", etc.). This file is only an example — the app reads data/config.json.

_field_notes.enabled: Master on/off. Leave false until you've filled in token + products.
_field_notes.endpoint: Where marketing-os listens. Default port 8765; change with the marketing-os setting job_server_port.
_field_notes.token: Copy from marketing-os: settings key job_server_token (printed to its console on boot, or read from data/harness.db settings). Must match or requests are rejected.
_field_notes.timeoutMs: How long to wait for the /generate POST to be accepted (not for the render).
_field_notes.autoPublish: false = marketing-os renders and holds the post in Create Studio for you to review/publish. true = it auto-runs the publish gate (duplicate + QC) and posts to the page.
_field_notes.anyPlatform: false = only trigger on the best FACEBOOK post. true = fall back to the best post on any platform if there was no Facebook post.
_field_notes.dedupeHours: A product that already has a live (non-failed) generation inside this window is not triggered again — this stops a rebuilt/re-sent report (a new report id) firing a second job. Manual `cli.js generate` bypasses it. Default 20.
_field_notes.fetchVisual: true = try to fetch the competitor creative (image/video URL) as a visual reference for the brief. Falls back to text-only if it can't.
_field_notes.brief.enabled: true = write the creative brief with the Claude CLI (grounded in the KB). false = use a plain template built from the captured analysis (no LLM call).
_field_notes.products: Map each product name (exactly as it appears in radar_sources.product) to its brand page. Address the page by ONE of: pageName (matches facebook_accounts.page_name), pageId (facebook_accounts.page_id), or accountId (facebook_accounts.id). kind: 'auto' mirrors the competitor post (video/reel -> video, else static), or force 'video' | 'static' | 'meme'. skill (optional) picks the marketing-os generation skill.
